details: slogsec is a malicious PyPI package from an earlier wave of the ChocoPoC campaign, in which fake CVE proof-of-concept repositories on GitHub target vulnerability researchers. It was presented as a colored, encrypted logger and listed as a dependency by lure repositories such as lincemorado97/CVE-2025-64446_CVE-2025-58034, lincemorado97/CVE-2025-55182_CVE-2025-66478 and lincemorado97/CVE-2025-14847. YesWeHack and Sekoia (2026-07-01) report that its code is very similar to the later skytext/frint chain, attribute both waves to the same actor with high confidence, and give the SHA-256 of slogsec 1.1.0 (released 2026-03-26) as 5abd45d6f4a1705dca55d882f017d4768888dce9ad99cea40b3da35c23de5cae. The package has been removed from PyPI.
